page.title: Skills
page.description: Register Claude Code skills. Published skills appear in the Skill Hub for all users and are served via /claude-code/marketplace.json.

delete.title: Delete Skill
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete skill: {{name}}?

sourceUrl.label: Source URL
sourceUrl.hint: Paste an HTTPS git repository URL from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or a self-hosted host (e.g. github.com/org/repo or github.com/org/repo/tree/main/my-skill), or an HTTPS link to a .zip archive of the skill hosted on S3 or any static file server.

subPath.label: Subfolder path (Optional)
subPath.hint: Path within the repository where the skill lives (e.g., plugins/my-skill). Leave empty if the skill is at the repo root.

lock.gitSubdir: The URL already points to a subfolder, so this field is disabled
lock.archive: A zip archive is installed as a whole, so this field is disabled

sha256.label: Archive SHA-256 (Optional)
sha256.hint: Hex digest of the zip file. Claude Code refuses to install the archive if its checksum does not match.

name.label: Skill Name
name.hint: Unique identifier in kebab-case format (e.g., my-skill)

domain.label: Domain (Optional)
domain.hint: Top-level grouping in the Skill Hub (e.g., Productivity)

description.label: Description (Optional)
description.hint: Brief description of what the skill does

category.label: Category (Optional)
category.hint: Select a category or enter a custom one

keywords.label: Keywords (Optional)
keywords.hint: Comma-separated list of keywords for search

authorName.label: Author Name (Optional)
authorName.hint: Name of the skill author or organization

authorEmail.label: Author Email (Optional)
authorEmail.hint: Contact email for the skill author

validation.sourceUrlRequired: Please enter a repository or zip archive URL
validation.subPathFormat: Subfolder must be a relative path like plugins/my-skill (letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, underscores)
validation.sha256: SHA-256 must be a 64-character hex digest
validation.nameFormat: Name must be kebab-case (lowercase, numbers, hyphens only)

toast.invalidSource: Please enter a valid repository or zip archive URL
toast.invalidVersion: Version must be in semantic versioning format (e.g., 1.0.0)
